title: Spicy Filipino Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy Filipino-inspired stew made with wholesome ingredients. This dish is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the sliced chili peppers and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the fish sauce, black pepper, and salt. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
